mentions.name: GGSQL
mentions.description: A grammar-of-graphics plotting layer inside SQL, built as the plotting half of Bedevere Wise. Users write declarative VISUALIZE syntax mapping columns to x, y, and color and issuing a DRAW command (e.g. DRAW point) to pop a chart in the editor, with nothing leaving the device.
mentions.audience: Biostatistics and clinical-data users of Bedevere Wise who want to chart datasets locally
mentions.source_excerpt: The plotting half is GGSQL. I read Thomas Lin Pedersen / Posit's alpha release a couple of weeks ago (https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47833558) and that's when I realised I could add the "Grammar of Graphics inside SQL" into Bedevere.
